messages:
rachel: Quick thread  Launch posts + webinar funnel SEO alignment. Need: keyword buckets, schema snippets, internal linking plan, and redirect rules. Also decide CTA anchors and inbound routing for leads. Who volunteers?

tom: Ill own keyword buckets + canonical targets. Proposed groups: 
  - intent: product (starter-kit)
  - intent: benchmark (bench-results)
  - intent: demo/webinar (register)
I'll attach a CSV to the ticket later.

vince: Ill take schema. We'll add Event JSON-LD on the webinar LP, FAQPage on benchmark, and BreadcrumbList on long posts. Also add `mainEntity` for top Qs.

yara: Tracking + routing: require distinct utm_content values: webinar_cta / bench_cta / kit_cta. Inbound routing: leads with utm_content=webinar_cta -> Sales Queue A; bench_cta -> SDR nurture. We'll set a server-side session cookie so UTM persists through redirects.

tom: Redirect rules (nginx examples):
```
# old article -> new launch landing (direct 301)
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# register endpoint fallback to /webinar-lp
location /register { try_files $uri $uri/ /webinar-lp; }
```
Mark 302 only for short experiments.

vince: Schema snippet I'll add to CMS: 
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Production inference","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
Also FAQPage for the benchmark with top 5 Qs.

yara: Routing note: ensure thank-you pages are `noindex, nofollow` and excluded from sitemap. Also set the TY URL to be excluded from inbound routing so only the LP receives external links.

rachel: Internal linking: add 2 contextual links from product docs and 1 from the homepage feature banner to the webinar LP. Use anchors: "Register" and "Read the benchmark". Keep anchor text short.

tom: After staging deploy, I'll run a staging crawl and list any redirect chains >1. If found we'll flatten to single-hop 301s to preserve link equity.

seo-bot: Preview build available: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-2026-preview - running crawl and structured data validation.

vince: One more: for benchmark post add `FAQPage` and `speakable` block for key headlines. Might help SERP highlights.

yara: I'll create routing matrix ticket in Linear and map UTMs -> queues -> cadence.

rachel: Ownership recap: tom = keywords + canonical map + redirects; vince = schema + JSON-LD; yara = UTMs + lead routing; rachel = content signoff + CRO experiments. Sync tomorrow 10am to review staging crawl and structured data. :calendar:
